text:
Riley: quick photo drop  Pickle got curious and burrowed into the ficus pot in the breakroom. picture: https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T02ABCDEF-F67890/pickle_in_ficus.jpg
Tess: noo adorable chaos :scream_cat: how is the plant?
Riley: plant survived, ferret victorious. soil everywhere, but Pickle is fine and extremely smug.
Marco: is this considered a security incident or a cute incident? :thinking_face:
Nina: cute incident with high cleanup overhead. rubber gloves volunteer?
Riley: I got the vacuum! and a tiny leaf crown for Pickle.
Tess: we need a professional caption. suggestions? winner gets honor of supplying treats next week.
Marco: "When your standup runs long so you start repotting"
Nina: "Operation: Leaf Me Alone"
Riley: "Sprint goal: maximum nap density"
Tess: (added :heart:)
Marco: (added :laughing:)
ops-bot: Heads up: please remember the office pet guidelines and schedule visits with People Ops if bringing animals on-site: https://redwood-internal/docs/office-pets
Riley: this was a supervised 10-min cameo. no full-time desk camping. just photo-sharing.
Nina: also, small poll: should we get a little harness so Pickle can safely explore during visits? react with :feeling_cute: for yes, :no_entry_sign: for no
Marco: (reacted :feeling_cute:)
Tess: (reacted :feeling_cute:)
Riley: (reacted :feeling_cute:)
Nina: great, I'll bring one next visit. size small recommended.
Marco: PSA: if you find potting soil on the kitchen floor, I accept bribes in the form of espresso shots.
Riley: milestone: Pickle now has more Slack appearances than my last demo. proud parent moment :relieved:
Tess: mandatory cameo at next all-hands?
Riley: optional cameo. I'll try to be camera-ready.
ops-bot: Poll created: "Pickle harness purchase?" options: yes/no  react to vote
Nina: thanks for indulging our ferret shenanigans, team. ending thread before the ficus stages a comeback. :seedling:
